BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 5, 2026, it repurchased 83,519 of its ordinary shares in the United States through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program up to $300 million, which is scheduled to conclude on April 28, 2026. The total number of ordinary shares acquired was 83,519, with an aggregate volume-weighted average price of $111.3718. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH plc will have 669,638,542 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.054% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 6 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 5 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 669,638,542 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.054% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
